subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/infra immersion and roster alignment
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@cobalthealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/infra immersion and roster alignment

Hi Tom / Nina —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML/infra leads:  

Summary from discovery:  
- Primary goal: validate end-to-end inference latency and cost for your batch/real-time mix, and confirm data-flow requirements for PHI-aware telemetry.  
- Key constraints: VPC-only deployment, HSM/KMS integration for keys, and 3rd-party model quantization tolerance.  
- Primary success criteria: <2x production latency vs. your benchmark and clear cost estimate per 1k tokens.

Proposed next step:  
1) 60–90 minute ML/infra immersion (we bring serving engineers + infra engineer + product)  
2) Agenda draft (attached): architecture walkthrough, sample workload replay, KV/cache strategy, rollout/fallback policies, and open Q&A targeted to your infra.  
3) Ask from you: confirm which Cobalt engineers should attend (ideally an infra/OPS lead + a data/ML engineer), and whether we should request limited sample payloads ahead of time.

Two availability windows (Pacific TZ) — if these don't work, share preferred times and we'll adapt:  
- Tues, Jun 24 — 10:00–11:30 PT (90m)  
- Wed, Jun 25 — 13:00–14:00 PT (60m)

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-immersion-agenda-v1.pdf] , [Attachment: COB-MAP-v2.xlsx]  
Calendly quick-pick: https://calendly.com/redwood/tdx-60-90  
Prep doc (read-only): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF-COB-tdx-prep

If you confirm attendees and pick a window, Soojin (cc'd) will coordinate ops/roster and Ben will bring the runbook and sample replay plan.

Thanks —
Lukas Meyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[lukas.meyer@redwood.com]

--
Attachment stubs: redwood-immersion-agenda-v1.pdf (7 pages), COB-MAP-v2.xlsx (2 sheets)

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule ML/infra immersion and roster alignment

Lukas —

Appreciate the concise recap. Both Nina and I reviewed the agenda quickly — looks good. A couple of notes:  
- Can we push the session to the following week? Jun 24/25 are tight for our infra team.  
- Suggested windows the week after (Pacific): Tue, Jul 1 11:00–12:30 or Thu, Jul 3 09:00–10:30. Either works for me.  
- Attendees on our side: me (product), Nina (security/compliance), and I’m trying to lock in Ravi Shah (platform lead) and Priya Menon (ML engineer). I’ll confirm by EOD next Tue.  

Also: we need a short pre-read for our security team that outlines data flows and KMS/HSM expectations. If you can point me to a one-pager (or add a slide in the agenda doc), that would help speed approvals.

Thanks —
Tom Ellis
Head of Product, Cobalt Health
[tom.ellis@cobalthealth.com]

Thanks Tom — good to hear. Two quick operational clarifications from our side as you confirm Ravi / Priya:  

1) Roster & roles we plan to bring (internal):  
- Soojin Lee — Solutions Architect (ops/rollout + demo owner)  
- Ben Carter — ML Engineer (replay + quantization experiments)  
- Marcus Lin — Serving runtime lead (will present kernel/latency optimizations) — if Marcus is needed I’ll add him to the invite (he’s available Thu, Jul 3 AM PT).  

2) Pre-read for security:  
- I added a KMS/HSM slide to the agenda doc (link below). The one-pager covers network controls, retention, and access policy. If Ravi’s team needs anything deeper (SOC2 artifact exports, encryption key lifecycle), ping me and we’ll triage with our security/compliance SMEs.  

3) Data for replay:  
- If you can provide a sanitized 1–2 minute sample stream and a sample prompt set in S3 or a secure link ahead of the session, Ben will wire up the replay and we’ll run the same through 3 model profiles. We only need a few MBs.  

Suggested session from our side (to match attendee load):  
- Thu, Jul 3 — 09:00–10:30 PT (90m) — gives Marcus a confirmed slot and gives us time to prep the replay.  

Links: agenda doc + security slide — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF-COB-tdx-prep

If Jul 3 works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Marcus. If not, we can default to Jul 1 11:00–12:30 PT.
